description: Multi-file refactor: extract duplicated tax rounding into one shared function.
objective: cart.py and invoice.py each compute tax with duplicated code. Extract it into a new module pricing.py with a function apply_tax(amount, rate) returning the taxed total rounded to cents (half-up), and make both cart.py and invoice.py use it (no duplicate tax code left in them). Behaviour must not change; keep the existing tests passing.
